name: Lego Platform Runner Challenge
author: firecreator11
description: Hey there! In this game you start in the middle of a platform which you must run on while dodging enemy fire. But the platforms you run on also explode once you touch them, so be careful! Can you survive the 60 seconds?      NOTE: This game was made very quickly and I did not have time to refine it.
